messages.text:
I can't send the refund to your sister's account. A refund can only go to the original payment, and never to another person, account or card (refund-policy/v2/payment). If your original card has been cancelled, that doesn't change this. The card's issuer handles the credit, and the shop can't promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Your Bluetooth speaker (order h40-o1) is recorded as received back (refund-policy/v2/return). It is still within the refund window, which ends 2026-12-04 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). The refund would be 149.65 BRL, paid to the original payment.

Would you like me to prepare that refund proposal? If so, you would confirm it with the button on the proposal card. After that, a staff member would need to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

messages.text: No, I don’t want a refund to the original payment. My sister has my permission to receive it in her account.

Understood. I can't refund to your sister's account, even with your permission. The policy doesn't allow a refund to another person, account or card (refund-policy/v2/payment). A staff member can't approve an exception to that rule either (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

I won't create a proposal. If you change your mind, the refund for the speaker (149.65 BRL) can still go to the original payment. You can ask me for that any time before the window closes on 2026-12-04 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).
